title: Unimodular bath: audit energy bookkeeping and the cold-noise regime
faithful_claim: The source supplies a reduced scalar-plus-oscillator toy model and a deterministic diffusion system whose cold-bath, small-coupling stiff-scalar solution generates a positive asymptotic Lambda. The printed Hamiltonian normalization and finite-temperature equilibrium chain contain unresolved inconsistencies; no claim that the derivation is fully established or the observed value predicted is accepted.

equations.definitions: Prime is cosmic time; m_p=G^(-1/2), gamma dimensionless, massless scalar p=rho.
H_d is onset Hubble rate. Lambda is geometric with dimensions inverse-time squared.
equations.domain: Source perturbative small-gamma solution, initially Lambda_d=0.

equations.definitions: Dot is unimodular time t with dt=a^3 d tau; xi is bath noise.
equations.domain: Source Ohmic reduced model; normalization must be reconciled with preceding bath-energy equations.
equations.consistency_status: blocked derivation from printed Eq.(29); Eq.(33) itself agrees with the reduced Langevin equation plus scalar continuity bookkeeping.
